_doc: Labelled windows of the raw CSI recordings (host/csi_sink.py --record). Times are seconds from the first record of the file. Labels: out | still | walk | live | unknown; transition windows carry 'enter' / 'leave'. Only windows whose ground truth is certain are scored. Recordings live in ~/.atech/recordings (not in git); trimmed fixtures in tests/fixtures.

room.name: owner flat, main room
room.board: Atech 14port, ESP32-S3, module ruview_csi, display ports 1-2, button port 3
room.csi_source: router ICMP echo replies, HT20, channel 6, RSSI -39..-58 dBm

positions.chair: 1-2 m from the board, on the router-board path (button protocol 'still')
positions.desk: owner's desk, off the router-board path (uncertain windows only)

room.notes: Frame layout flips 256/384 bytes with link quality. Floor plan sketch: TODO owner.

sessions.firmware: feat/atech 9a401aa..1ac9122 (20 Hz pings, all-LTF layout, csi_cfg 0)
sessions.unknown: everything else in this file: owner at the desk or moving about; label 'still' from 6974 s onwards is not ground truth
